chapter_meta_description: The Diancai Immortal overcomes the Six-Nine Tribulation and achieves the Golden Core. Ji Ning learns the truth of the ambush and uncovers the location of the mysterious faction: the Eastwood School.
og_title: Desolate Era 419: The Cradle of a Celestial Immortal
og_description: Seven-colored clouds, blooming golden lotuses, and a cosmic resonance mark Diancai’s breakthrough. But as Ji Ning celebrates, Blooddrop flees—and a hidden faction is exposed.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 419: Celestial Ascension & Hidden Danger
twitter_description: Ji Ning’s master becomes a true Celestial Immortal, free from all tribulations. The celebration is cut short as Ji Ning tracks down the mysterious faction behind the assassination.

lore_anchors.definition: In Daoist alchemy, a condensate of one’s essence, energy, and spirit; in Desolate Era, it marks the final unity of the Primal soul and Yuan power, granting true immortality and freedom from periodic tribulations.

A Heavenly Tribulation involving 54 thunderbolts; a cultivator who overcomes this threshold is considered a legitimate, powerful Celestial Immortal, far above those who only passed a weaker tribulation.
Periodic heavenly ordeals faced by all cultivators below the Celestial Immortal level; minor disasters every 300 years and major calamities every 900 years.

The ruling marquis clan of the Anchan Commandery; they protect sects like the Black-White College in exchange for talent recruitment rights and loyalty; a Celestial Immortal in the college shifts the power balance.
A rare, one-use talisman that allows instantaneous teleportation across the world; considered a high-value escape tool used only in desperate situations.
The most dangerous stage of the Six-Nine Tribulation, targeting a cultivator’s Dao-heart and emotional weaknesses; the victim is completely helpless to the outside world during this phase.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What exactly happens when a cultivator becomes a Celestial Immortal?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Their Primal soul, Yuan power, and everything else fuse into a single Golden Core. They gain an ‘Immortal aura,’ become free from the Three Calamities and Nine Tribulations, and are said to have ‘leaped beyond the Three Realms and escaped the Five Elements.’

The oldest Loose Immortal of the Black-White College, known for his slovenly appearance and excitable, madman-like personality. He is the senior disciple-brother of the Diancai Immortal and serves as the college’s eccentric herald.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Blooddrop wait so long to escape?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He was curious to see if the Diancai Immortal would successfully ascend to Celestial Immortality. Only after confirming the result did he use his Greater Teleportation Dao-seal to flee, treating the loss of a treasure as a worthwhile price for the knowledge.
